question: What conduct should be abandoned once practice yields an even mind?
premises: Practice leads to an even mind.
Village or conventional duty is named.
An injunction to abandon it is given.
inference: One who attains mental evenness through practice should abandon conventional worldly duties.
uncertainties: grāma dharmañ may refer broadly to social or household duties.
plain_english: Through practice, when the mind becomes even, one should abandon the duties of ordinary village life.
